GetShowProperties.description: Catalog — All shows (show_id + propertyId) across all MGM properties. Entry point for discovery.

GetShow.description: Show detail — name, descriptions, images, property info, dark dates, seasons.

GetShowEventsView.description: Event schedule — paginated list of upcoming events for a show with dates, times, lowestPrice, eventId.
GetShowEventsView.notes: Paginate by incrementing offset by limit until events array is empty.

GetCalendarView.description: Calendar view — per-day availability and lowest price for a month range.

GetSeatsAvailability.description: INVENTORY — Full seat-level availability per event. Returns sections > rows > seat ranges with prices. This is the key scraping target.

GetOffers.description: Available promotional programs (discounts, MyVegas comps) for a show.
